title: Reactive State with Svelte Stores — Examples
title_es: Estado Reactivo con Svelte Stores — Ejemplos
description: Runnable Svelte store examples: writable and readable stores, a derived cart store, a custom store with a contract-based API, localStorage persistence, and store tests with Vitest.
description_es: Ejemplos ejecutables de stores de Svelte: stores writable y readable, store derived de carrito, store personalizado con API por contrato, persistencia en localStorage y tests de stores con Vitest.
